title: Add single tag ZIP download
context: Download one release as a single ZIP that contains the repository tree at the tag.

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: `download.sh <repo> <tag>` writes a ZIP to a chosen path.
The ZIP contains the tree at the tag, not `main`.
The SHA256 is printed and written next to the archive.
A missing tag fails with a clear message.
Works for public and private repositories.
